force_powers.description: Force powers available to Force-sensitive characters. Divided into Light Side and Dark Side powers, with some powers available to both.

light_side_powers.name: Force Heal
light_side_powers.description: Channel the Light Side to heal wounds and restore vitality to oneself or allies.
light_side_powers.effect: Restore 1-3 shield or hull wounds to a friendly unit within range

light_side_powers.name: Force Speed
light_side_powers.description: Enhance physical speed beyond normal limits, appearing as a blur of motion.
light_side_powers.effect: Unit gains +3 movement for one activation and +1 attack dice

light_side_powers.name: Force Push
light_side_powers.description: Explosive kinetic blast that knocks back opponents.
light_side_powers.effect: Target enemy unit is pushed back 2 inches and may be disrupted

light_side_powers.name: Force Pull
light_side_powers.description: Draw objects or beings toward the user with the Force.
light_side_powers.effect: Target enemy unit is pulled 2 inches toward the user

light_side_powers.name: Force Sense
light_side_powers.description: Heightened awareness of the surroundings through the Force. Detect disturbances, emotions, and hidden presences.
light_side_powers.effect: Reveal hidden units within range; gain forewarning of attacks

light_side_powers.name: Force Barrier
light_side_powers.description: Create a protective barrier of Force energy that absorbs incoming attacks.
light_side_powers.effect: Create a barrier that blocks the next attack against the user or an ally

light_side_powers.name: Force Jump
light_side_powers.description: Leap great distances or heights using the Force.
light_side_powers.effect: Unit can jump over terrain obstacles and difficult terrain

light_side_powers.name: Jedi Mind Trick
light_side_powers.description: Influence the thoughts and actions of weak-minded beings through the Force.
light_side_powers.effect: Target enemy unit is disrupted for 1 round (cannot act)

light_side_powers.name: Force Ghost
light_side_powers.description: After death, project one's consciousness as a Force spirit. A rare ability mastered by only the greatest Jedi.
light_side_powers.effect: Character appears as a Force ghost, providing guidance and limited Force abilities

light_side_powers.name: Force Dyad
light_side_powers.description: An extremely rare connection between two Force-sensitives who share a bond across any distance. They draw power from each other.
light_side_powers.effect: Both dyad members gain enhanced Force abilities when near each other; can sense each other across the galaxy

dark_side_powers.name: Force Lightning
dark_side_powers.description: Bolt of raw Dark Side energy that inflicts agony and destruction. The signature power of Emperor Palpatine.
dark_side_powers.effect: Deal 2-5 damage to target unit; can chain to multiple targets at higher ranks

dark_side_powers.name: Force Choke
dark_side_powers.description: Crush a target's throat from a distance using the Force. The signature power of Darth Vader.
dark_side_powers.effect: Target unit is choked: cannot act and loses 1 wound per round until released

dark_side_powers.name: Force Drain
dark_side_powers.description: Drain the life force from a target, transferring their vitality to the user.
dark_side_powers.effect: Target loses 2-4 wounds; user heals an equal amount

dark_side_powers.name: Force Fear
dark_side_powers.description: Instill overwhelming fear in enemies, causing them to flee or freeze.
dark_side_powers.effect: All enemy units within range are disrupted and must pass a morale check or flee

dark_side_powers.name: Force Domination
dark_side_powers.description: Overpower a target's will and control their actions through the Dark Side.
dark_side_powers.effect: Target unit is controlled by the user for 1 round

dark_side_powers.name: Sith Rage
dark_side_powers.description: Channel Dark Side emotions into a frenzy of power, increasing combat ability at the cost of control.
dark_side_powers.effect: User gains +2 attack and +1 damage for 2 rounds, but cannot defend

dark_side_powers.name: Force Drown
dark_side_powers.description: Suffocate a target by filling their lungs with water or air, even in dry environments.
dark_side_powers.effect: Target loses 1-3 wounds over 2 rounds as they suffocate

dark_side_powers.name: Sith Alchemy
dark_side_powers.description: Forbidden Dark Side knowledge to cheat death and return from the dead. The ultimate Dark Side power.
dark_side_powers.effect: User returns from death in a new body, greatly weakened but still powerful

dark_side_powers.name: Dark Side Aura
dark_side_powers.description: Project an aura of Dark Side energy that intimidates and weakens nearby enemies.
dark_side_powers.effect: Enemy units within range lose 1 attack and 1 defense

leader_abilities.description: Unique leader abilities from Star Wars: Legion and other games. Each leader has special command cards and passive abilities.

abilities.name: TIE Advanced x1
abilities.effect: Deploy a TIE Advanced that can attack ground units. Provides orbital strike support.

abilities.name: Fear of the Dark Side
abilities.effect: Enemy units within 6 inches of Vader lose 1 attack dice and cannot recover green tokens.

abilities.name: Imperial Supremacy
abilities.effect: All Imperial units gain +1 attack for the activation phase. Vader can activate twice.

abilities.name: Force Choke
abilities.effect: Target enemy commander within 8 inches is disrupted and cannot issue orders for 1 round.

abilities.name: Tarkin Doctrine
abilities.effect: Imperial units in systems with Imperial loyalty gain +1 attack and defense.

abilities.name: Orbital Strike
abilities.effect: Call in a Star Destroyer orbital bombardment on a ground hex. Deals 3 damage to all units in the hex.

abilities.name: Governor's Authority
abilities.effect: All Imperial units gain Standby tokens, allowing them to activate later in the phase.

abilities.name: Tactical Genius
abilities.effect: Thrawn can see enemy command cards before playing his own. Gains +1 defense in all combats.

abilities.name: Flank and Destroy
abilities.effect: All Imperial units gain +2 movement for the activation phase. Units that move gain +1 attack.

abilities.name: Art Collection
abilities.effect: Thrawn's units ignore difficult terrain. Imperial units adjacent to Thrawn gain +1 defense.

abilities.name: X-Wing Pilot
abilities.effect: Deploy Luke's X-Wing for orbital support. Can make a single attack against a ground unit.

abilities.name: Jedi Training
abilities.effect: Rebel units within 6 inches of Luke gain +1 defense. Luke can use Force Push as a free action.

abilities.name: Hope of the Rebellion
abilities.effect: All Rebel units recover 1 shield wound. Rebel units gain +1 attack for the activation phase.

abilities.name: Force Heal
abilities.effect: Heal 2 hull wounds on a friendly unit within 4 inches.

abilities.name: Incredible Pilot
abilities.effect: Han can deploy the Millennium Falcon for orbital strikes. Falcon arrives after Round 2.

abilities.name: Millennium Falcon Run
abilities.effect: Millennium Falcon makes a bombing run, dealing 4 damage to a target unit or hex.

abilities.name: Rebel General
abilities.effect: All Rebel units gain +1 movement and +1 attack for the activation phase.

abilities.name: Rebel Leadership
abilities.effect: Rebel units within 6 inches of Leia gain +1 defense. Leia cannot be targeted by enemy abilities.

abilities.name: Hope and Inspiration
abilities.effect: All Rebel units gain a Standby token. Rebel units recover 1 shield wound.

abilities.name: Diplomatic Immunity
abilities.effect: Leia cannot be targeted by enemy attacks. If Leia is eliminated, Rebels lose 1 victory point.

abilities.name: Red Leader
abilities.effect: Rebel units within 6 inches of Wedge gain +1 attack. Wedge can issue orders to units outside command range.

abilities.name: Ace Pilot
abilities.effect: Deploy X-Wing squadron for orbital strike. All Rebel units gain +1 attack dice.

abilities.name: Battle-Hardened
abilities.effect: Wedge's units ignore suppression tokens. Wedge gains +1 defense after Round 3.

abilities.name: Jedi Wisdom
abilities.effect: Yoda can use Force Sense to reveal hidden units. Republic units within 6 inches gain +1 defense.

abilities.name: Force Mastery
abilities.effect: Yoda can use Force Push on all enemy units within 8 inches. Republic units gain +1 attack.

abilities.name: Ancient Knowledge
abilities.effect: Yoda can reroll 1 attack die per round. Republic units adjacent to Yoda gain +1 defense.

abilities.name: Clone Army Tactics
abilities.effect: All Clone units gain +1 movement and can issue orders outside command range.

abilities.name: Jedi Defense
abilities.effect: Obi-Wan gains +2 defense when defending. Republic units within 4 inches gain +1 defense.

abilities.name: Watchful Guardian
abilities.effect: Obi-Wan can use Force Push. All Republic units recover 1 shield wound.

abilities.name: The Chosen One
abilities.effect: Anakin gains +1 attack and +1 defense. Republic units within 6 inches gain +1 attack.

abilities.name: Force Speed
abilities.effect: Anakin gains +3 movement and can attack twice this activation.

abilities.name: General's Authority
abilities.effect: All Republic units gain +1 attack. Clone units can activate before their normal order.

abilities.name: Vaapad Master
abilities.effect: Mace Windu gains +2 attack when defending. Enemy units within 4 inches lose 1 attack.

abilities.name: Jedi Council Authority
abilities.effect: All Jedi units gain +1 attack and defense. Republic units within 6 inches gain +1 defense.

abilities.name: Purple Lightsaber
abilities.effect: Mace Windu's attacks deal 1 extra damage to Dark Side users.

abilities.name: Droid Army Surge
abilities.effect: All droid units gain +1 movement and +1 attack for the activation phase.

abilities.name: Lightsaber Collection
abilities.effect: Grievous gains +2 attack in close combat. Can wield 4 lightsabers simultaneously.

abilities.name: Tactical Retreat
abilities.effect: Grievous can retreat through a dropship, removing him from the board and redeploying next round.

abilities.name: Sith Deception
abilities.effect: Dooku can disguise himself as a Jedi. Enemy units cannot target Dooku with abilities.

abilities.name: Force Lightning Strike
abilities.effect: Dooku uses Force Lightning on a target unit within 6 inches, dealing 3 damage.

abilities.name: Separatist Command
abilities.effect: All Separatist units gain +1 attack. Droid units can activate before their normal order.

abilities.name: Dark Side Fury
abilities.effect: Kylo Ren gains +2 attack and +1 damage for 2 rounds. First Order units within 6 inches gain +1 attack.

abilities.name: First Order Command
abilities.effect: All First Order units gain +1 movement and +1 attack for the activation phase.

abilities.name: Sith Inheritance
abilities.effect: Kylo Ren can use Force Choke. Enemy units within 4 inches lose 1 defense.

abilities.name: Jedi Training
abilities.effect: Rey gains +1 attack and defense. Resistance units within 6 inches gain +1 defense.

abilities.name: Force Dyad
abilities.effect: Rey can sense Kylo Ren across the galaxy. If Kylo Ren is on the board, Rey gains +1 attack and defense.

abilities.name: Scavenger Resourcefulness
abilities.effect: Rey can repair 1 hull wound on a friendly unit each round. Resistance units adjacent to Rey gain +1 defense.

abilities.name: Resistance Ace
abilities.effect: Deploy Poe's X-Wing for orbital strike. All Resistance units gain +1 attack.

abilities.name: Fearless Pilot
abilities.effect: Poe gains +1 attack when attacking from movement. Resistance units within 6 inches gain +1 attack.

abilities.name: Modified X-Wing
abilities.effect: Poe's X-Wing can carry torpedoes. Deals 2 extra damage with torpedo attacks.

abilities.name: Sith Rule
abilities.effect: All Sith and Imperial units within 8 inches gain +1 attack. Enemy units within 4 inches lose 1 defense.

abilities.name: Force Lightning Storm
abilities.effect: Palpatine uses Force Lightning on all enemy units within 6 inches, dealing 2 damage to each.

abilities.name: Emperor's Will
abilities.effect: All friendly units gain +1 attack and defense. Palpatine can use Force Drain to heal 2 wounds.

abilities.name: Immortality
abilities.effect: If Palpatine is eliminated, he can return from death once per game with 1 wound.

abilities.name: Mandalorian Armor
abilities.effect: Boba Fett gains +2 defense. Cannot be eliminated by the first hit that would eliminate him.

abilities.name: Expert Tracker
abilities.effect: Reveal all hidden enemy units within 12 inches. Boba Fett gains +1 attack for the activation phase.

abilities.name: Slave I
abilities.effect: Deploy Slave I for orbital strike. Deals 3 damage to a target unit or hex.

unit_keywords.description: Common unit keywords and abilities found across Star Wars tabletop games.

keywords.name: Elite
keywords.effect: Unit gains +1 attack and +1 defense. Elite units are fewer in number but more capable.

keywords.name: Mass Produced
keywords.effect: Unit can be fielded in larger numbers but has reduced individual stats.

keywords.name: Force Sensitive
keywords.effect: Unit can use Force powers. Gains access to Force abilities based on rank.

keywords.name: Heavy Armor
keywords.effect: Unit gains +2 defense but loses 1 movement. Resistant to suppression.

keywords.name: Speed
keywords.effect: Unit gains +2 movement. Can move through difficult terrain without penalty.

keywords.name: Long Range
keywords.effect: Unit's weapons have extended range. Can attack at Range 3 without penalty.

keywords.name: Suppression
keywords.effect: Unit's attacks can place suppression tokens on enemy units, reducing their effectiveness.

keywords.name: Stealth
keywords.effect: Unit can hide and is not visible to enemies until it attacks or is revealed.

keywords.name: Transport
keywords.effect: Unit can carry other units. Transported units move with the transport.

keywords.name: Droid
keywords.effect: Unit is a droid. Vulnerable to EMP and remote shutdown. Does not feel fear.

keywords.name: Clone
keywords.effect: Unit is a clone trooper. Gains bonuses when near Jedi commanders. Vulnerable to Order 66.

keywords.name: Creature
keywords.effect: Unit is a non-humanoid creature. May have unique movement and attack rules.

keywords.name: Walker
keywords.effect: Unit is a large walker. Can move over difficult terrain. Vulnerable to specific weaknesses.

keywords.name: Starfighter
keywords.effect: Unit is a starfighter. Uses space combat rules. Has firing arcs and maneuver dials.

keywords.name: Capital Ship
keywords.effect: Unit is a capital ship. Has massive hull and shield values. Can deploy starfighters.
